item.description: Hugo ships with several Built-in Shortcodes for rich content, along with a Privacy Config and a set of Simple Shortcodes that enable static and no-JS versions of various social media embeds.

item.title: Page Ttile
item.description:
Before rendering this page, define a new “menu” in hugo.yaml.

menu:
  main:
    - identifier: NewPage
      name: NewPage
      url: /new-page # Should be the same as above "url"

content/page/*.md is mapped to layouts/page/single.html.

otherwhise, every page in content/*.md should specifiy “type” and “layout” parameters.
